transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on sequencing batches R, Q, and P for Furnace 7's next production window. Before I finalize the sequence, I need to hear from each of you — maintenance, quality, logistics, and process safety — so we can get sign-off and I can release the schedule. Does anyone have any constraints or concerns I should factor into the sequencing decision?

transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a maintenance constraint before we proceed. My inspection found that Furnace 7's thermocouple calibration certificate expires before this production window. I haven't updated the maintenance board yet because the inspection was completed after the morning planning cutoff, so this may not be reflected in the information everyone else is working from.

commitments.detail: Thermocouple recalibration (2 hours) must be completed before any batch runs. Schedule this prior to startup.
Gas analyzer spare replacement must be completed and verified before any batch runs. No heat-treatment begins until this is confirmed.
Batch R runs first to ensure the staged alloy charge does not exceed the 4-hour oxidation limit at the furnace bay.
